verses.1: A song of ascents. When the LORD restored the fortunes of Zion, we were like those who dream.
verses.2: Then our mouths were filled with laughter, and our tongues with songs of joy. Then it was said among the nations, "The LORD has done great things for them."
verses.3: The LORD has done great things for us; we were glad.
verses.4: Restore our fortunes, O LORD, like the streams in the Negev.
verses.5: Those who sow in tears will reap with songs of joy.
verses.6: Those who go forth weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will come back with songs of joy, carrying their sheaves.

notes:
Notes
- v. 1: "restored the fortunes of Zion" translates שׁוּב שִׁיבַת צִיּוֹן (shuv shivat Tzion), a poetic expression for the return from exile.
- v. 4: "streams in the Negev" translates כַּאֲפִיקִים בַּנֶּֽגֶב (ka'afiqim ba'negav), referring to sudden torrents of rain in the arid Negev region, symbolizing a miraculous renewal.

[3] The LORD has done great things for us; we were glad.
[4] Restore our fortunes, O LORD, like the streams in the Negev.
[5] Those who sow in tears will reap with songs of joy.
[6] Those who go forth weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will come back with songs of joy, carrying their sheaves.
